name: spotify lookup
tagline: Resolve batches of loosely specified tracks against Spotify, and control playback with every command confirmed on the device.
description: Submit an array of { name, artist?, album?, year? } and get back one fully populated result per item, in order, each with its own status. It holds no Spotify credential of its own: every request carries the caller's keyring token and keyring hands over the headers for that person's own connection. 100% coverage.
highlights: Batch, order-preserving resolution with per-item status
Playback commands confirmed on the device
